answer_1.quote: We conduct extensive experiments to investigate the personalization ability of state-of-the-art ... models as personalized assistants.

answer_2.quote: Conventionally, BLEU and ROUGE-L are adopted to evaluate LLMs' responses, although they were not devised to assess the conversational capability of LLMs.

answer_3.quote: we replace human evaluators with GPT-4o... The prompt asks GPT-4o to choose among the GT personalized answer, model-generated response, and "Tie". We further streamline the evaluation process by training a smaller Llama-3.2-3B model as a proxy evaluator.

answer_4.quote: To obtain human evaluation results, we recruit 10 human evaluators per model who are asked to choose which one of the ground truth (GT) personalized answers in the QA pair and the model-generated response they prefer.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators choose preferred response between ground-truth personalized answer and model-generated response, with optional "Tie" option.
